name: Re:Set Episode 3 : It's Raining Acid
source:
“Two demons sealed, five more to go! Right now we’re tracking down a criminal called Carcajou who caused several disappearances, and whom I believed to be Dio, the demon of gluttony. But it’s not that simple, someone from my past shows up and changes everything I thought I knew about the demons. Who would’ve thought that we’re not the only ones chasing them?”

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28030]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
